## 2. Executive Summary

The host says the White House Military Office sent a communications email at about 9:49 p.m. Eastern on the night of the White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting, and that the White House then tried to rescind it. She dates the shooting to 8:36 p.m. and says Sara Sidner of CNN was the first to post Erika Kirk's "I just want to go home" clip, at 9:25 p.m., citing Instagram metadata (A-2575.1). She reads the part of the email that calls the clip the incident's "strongest emotional response" asset and recommends that all channels and "approved surrogates" amplify it overnight (A-2574.1). The host does not show the email. She says the Department of Defense uses a "canary" watermarking tactic to trace leakers, and she names three people she says were copied: Steven Cheung, Ryan Rippeon and Gustav Anderly of the White House Communications Agency. She adds that, according to her sources, the recall failed and recipients were ordered to delete the email (A-2574.2).

The host then relays a tips-line story she says was verified with receipts (A-2576.1). According to the host, Justin Streiff, who had been promoted to TPUSA chief operating officer seven days before the assassination, allegedly called a book printer on September 10 to at least double the order for Charlie Kirk's book "Stop in the Name of God", after getting Erika Kirk's approval. She repeats an outside source's and an insider's accounts that about $10 million was missing from Turning Point Action. She also says Streiff runs Winning Team Publishing, which Sergio Gor and Donald Trump Jr. founded. She relays a rumor that Gor left his White House deputy chief of staff role after clashing with Elon Musk, including over Jared Isaacman's appointment, and over an alleged relationship. She plays Erika Kirk's remarks at Gor's ambassador-to-India ceremony (A-2577.1).

In later segments the host mocks Jessica Reed Kraus's posts relaying praise from Nick Shirley's elementary school teachers, together with Shirley's reply (A-2578). She shows a Times headline saying Brigitte Macron slapped her husband over text messages to an Iranian actress (A-2579). In the comments she says Captain Adam Neff was found and confirmed questioning Mitch Snow. She also says TPUSA is now paying chapter leaders not to close chapters and that her merch had its highest sales day after the "boycott advertisers" campaign.

lines: ## 7. Optional Flags

- **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2574.1 (the White House Military Office email is read aloud but deliberately not shown, which the host attributes to canary watermarking), A-2574.2 (deletion-order emails), A-2576.1 (tips-line receipts) and A-2580.1 (Blake Neff's X posts).

- **Skeleton handling**: The existing N-16 and N-160 rows and the M-42 occurrence are kept with their ids and text; only their placeholder *Related:* lines were filled in. The N-160 description mentions an "Epstein situation-room attendee read", which does not appear in this transcript; it is kept verbatim from the skeleton. The skeleton's ledger line "Hole-minted Nodes (remap-ep104): N-160" was replaced by "(see registers)" per the spec. Its Video Timestamp Range (00:56:29) was corrected to the transcript duration, 49:46.

- **Name matching**: "Justin Streiff" (chapter title "Justin Streiff") is mapped to N-15. "Blake Neff" is N-159 Blake Neff. "Captain Adam Neff" / "Commander Neff" is N-319. "Sarah Seidner" is N-370 Sara Sidner. "Don Trump Jr." is N-33. The "mysterious Pierre" is linked only to topic N-10280; he is not matched to the existing Pierre S. du Pont person node, because the transcript gives no surname.

- **New-person spellings**: "Ryan Rippeon" and "Gustav Anderly" are kept as spoken; real spellings are unverified. N-610 is named Jessica Reed Kraus (transcript "Jessica Reed Krauss", handle rendered "House and Drinking Habit"). For N-623, the host says she is "definitely not saying this name right" ("Golshifteh Farahani", "Golshifteh Farahani", "Farahani", "Farahani", "Farahani"). The node is named Golshifteh Farahani, the exiled Iranian actress whose name these spellings appear to render; the integrator should verify this. "Ike Cromoter" (21:13), named as someone whose "guy" Gor is, could not be matched and was not minted.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: "rescend" / "resend" for rescind, and "plat platforms", are kept as written. "Brigitte / Brigitte / Brigitte Macron" (Brigitte Macron), "Emmanuel Macron", "capta" (CAPTCHA) and "Vavlla" (favela) are kept as written. The host says Streiff "he's not just the CEO" (20:14) but elsewhere calls him COO; COO is used.

- **Possible cross-episode links left out**: C-9211 was not linked to C-8573 (Washington Post: Secret Service fired at the WHCD suspect), because the host says the agents fired "at one another", a different proposition. C-9244–C-9246 were not linked to C-9082/C-7382 (Nick Shirley's own infiltration claims), because they concern teacher praise, not the infiltration. C-9228–C-9230 were not linked to C-5184 (Buckmans' $10 million gift), which is a different proposition.
- **Not inscribed as claims (admission test)**: Several statements were not inscribed:
- The host's multiple-choice "game" about September 10 priorities
- "Erika is just different" and "born for this role" characterizations (kept as meme M-94)
- "Israel's guy Sergio Gor" and "the Trump whisperer"
- Her opinion that Charlie "suddenly realize[d] that money was evaporating"
- The speculation that an anti-Israel turn would have been costly to Erika Kirk and sponsors
- The warning to Blake Neff about a "background lead" (no content given)
- The family-reunion and "gated communities" riffs at Nick Shirley
- The "two birds one stone… Iran's oil" joke
- The claim that "everybody kind of knows Emmanuel Macron's gay"

- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: The host says the clip was "a little over an hour after the shooting" in some places and "less than 20 minutes" after the Sidner upload in others; both are preserved where quoted. Other beats left out:
- The top comment from "A Detto" about São Paulo police avoiding PCC turf
- A viewer's report that Brazilian gangs run paid tours
- The Michael Jackson estate and Beatles catalog remarks
- Kelly Martin's report of receiving a TPUSA / Riley Gaines fundraising letter
- The Macron court date "June"
- The book club starting Friday
- The Salem Media mention

- **DIA scan**: The only keyword hit is "tips line" (14:41), which is treated as a DIA beat (C-9224, A-2576.1, M-12). There is no hit for "tips at", "more tips", "candaceowens.com", "decentralized", "dcia" or "bounty". The CIA / Candace Intelligence Agency phrase does not air, so M-14 is not used.
- **Sponsor reads** (Kickoff, The Wellness Company) and merch/book promotion are excluded.
